description: Renovate only looks in .github/workflows by default. This repository is on Forgejo, so
without this the actions pinned in the build workflow would never be updated at all.
Quarkus stays on the 3.33 LTS line. Patch releases within it are wanted - they are what
an LTS line is for - but 3.34 and later are not, because leaving LTS is a decision, not a
dependency bump.
One rule covers all of it: quarkus-bom, quarkus-mcp-server-bom, quarkus-langchain4j-bom and
the Maven plugin all read the same quarkus.platform.version property, so a single update
would move the whole platform at once.
The bound is written as a Maven range, not as '<3.34': allowedVersions is interpreted in
the versioning scheme of the datasource, which is maven here. The half-open upper bound is
what admits 3.33.3.1 while excluding every 3.34.
The LangChain4j embedding artifacts are only ever released as -beta, so the usual advice
to ignore unstable versions would freeze them forever. Their versions come from
quarkus-langchain4j-bom, so this matters only if one is ever pinned directly.
The parser libraries are pinned in pom.xml and carry the real risk of a silent behaviour
change - chunking that shifts moves every chunk boundary and needs a full reindex. Kept
separate so such a bump is reviewed on its own rather than inside a batch.
The base image tag moves often and is low risk; the JDK line in its name is not something
Renovate should change - Java 25 is the minimum this project compiles against.
A security fix is worth a pull request outside the usual schedule. The Quarkus pin above
still applies: a CVE fix inside 3.33.x comes through, a jump to 3.34 does not.
